    Design

    Architectural and urban design projects that integrate computational methods with traditional design practice.

    Current Practice

    Partner Architect, Ar-ge Architects (2024-present) Leading architectural design projects that combine research expertise with practical design solutions. Focus on data-driven design decisions, sustainable architecture, and computational design methods.

    Current Project Types:

    • Residential architecture with smart home integration
    • Mixed-use developments with transit-oriented design
    • Public spaces incorporating pedestrian behavior analysis
    • Urban regeneration projects using evidence-based planning

    Design Philosophy: Integration of urban analytics and research findings into architectural practice. Using insights from mobility studies, environmental analysis, and user behavior research to inform spatial design decisions.

    Past Projects

    Hue City Urban Masterplan, Vietnam (2015-2016) Research Intern, Seoul National University / KOICA ODA Project

    Comprehensive urban masterplan development for the former imperial capital, balancing heritage preservation with modern development needs. Project addressed sustainable urban growth while respecting UNESCO World Heritage status.

    Key Contributions:

    • GIS analysis and spatial planning for historic city center
    • Integration of traditional Vietnamese urban design principles
    • Infrastructure planning and transportation network design
    • Cultural corridor development connecting historical sites
    • Community consultation and stakeholder engagement

    Project Scope:

    • Scale: City-wide comprehensive planning
    • Challenge: Modernization while preserving cultural heritage
    • Approach: Evidence-based planning with cultural sensitivity
    • Outcome: Comprehensive masterplan and implementation guidelines

    Design Expertise

    Computational Design:

    • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and parametric design
    • Performance optimization through environmental simulation
    • Data-driven site analysis and programming

    Sustainable Architecture:

    • Climate-responsive design strategies
    • Passive design systems and energy efficiency
    • Material innovation and local sourcing

    Urban Design:

    • Master planning and neighborhood design
    • Public space design with pedestrian focus
    • Transit-oriented development
    • Heritage preservation and adaptive reuse

    Evidence-Based Design:

    • User behavior analysis informing spatial design
    • Post-occupancy evaluation and design iteration
    • Integration of research findings into design practice

    Research-Practice Integration

    The combination of academic research and design practice creates opportunities for:

    • Testing design hypotheses through built projects
    • Applying research insights to real-world design challenges
    • Contributing to evidence-based design methodologies
    • Bridging gap between urban research and architectural practice

    This dual role allows for unique projects that leverage computational analysis, user behavior studies, and urban analytics to create more responsive and effective built environments.
